catalog_description: Computed flow measurements for a value stream over a period, covering velocity, time, load, efficiency, and distribution.
Configured definitions of flow metrics with their thresholds and targets, against which measured flow is evaluated.
Remediation actions from audit findings, tracking owner, target date, evidence, and closure date.
Food safety deviations, complaints, and non-conformance events that trigger investigation and corrective or preventive action.
Historical comparisons of submitted forecasts against actual results, used to measure and improve forecast accuracy.
Manager overrides applied to submitted forecasts, capturing the changed number and the reason for the adjustment.
Forecast submissions for a period, moving from draft to submitted to locked as the forecast cadence closes.
Targeted announcements sent to frontline audiences, with optional mandatory-read, scheduled delivery, and acknowledgment tracking.
Reusable templates of ordered task items (opening, closing, audit, compliance) run against a location and shift by frontline workers.
Per-worker records that a frontline learning module was completed, with score or pass status where assessed.
Bite-size training units delivered to frontline workers on mobile devices, tracked per worker and role.
Delivery channels through which broadcasts and conversations reach deskless workers, such as location feeds, team channels, kiosks, and SMS fallback.
Peer or manager recognitions of frontline workers, shown in the frontline feed and visible to the team.
Per-worker submissions completing a frontline task or checklist item, carrying the photo, form, or attestation evidence required.
Units of work pushed to frontline workers or locations, completed on a mobile or shared device with photo or form evidence.
Reconciliation records for fuel tanks: opening volume, deliveries, pump totals, closing reading, and variance, kept for storage-tank compliance.
Fuel-dock transactions: product, gallons, pump, price, and the boater or vessel charged.
Bulk fuel storage tanks at the marina, with product, capacity, and current volume, reconciled against deliveries and sales.
Fuel-card and charging-network transactions for vehicles, capturing driver, fuel type, quantity, cost, location, and time, used for tax reporting and exception detection.
Fulfillment instructions created from order lines, assigned to a warehouse or location and tracked through to shipment.
Accounting close cycles for a fund (monthly, quarterly, annual) that drive statement generation and audit packaging.
Waterfall payouts from a real-estate fund to limited and general partners, calculated on income, sale, or refinancing events.
End-to-end fund-vehicle setup records, covering entity formation filings, tax-ID application, banking onboarding, and partnership agreement.
General-partner accounting entries against a fund vehicle: contributions, expenses, fee accruals, and gain or loss recognitions.
Fund-level performance reporting periods, with vintage-adjusted return metrics and benchmark comparisons.
Per-position return calculations on a fund's holding in a specific portfolio company, over a defined time window.
Private-capital fund vehicles in a partnership structure, with vintage, strategy, target size, and current assets under management.
Court-ordered or agency-issued instructions to withhold from an employee's wages, carrying priority, ceiling, remit-to details, and lifecycle status.
Consent records for learner training data under GDPR, capturing purpose, lawful basis, and grant and withdrawal timestamps.
Accounts in the chart of accounts, with code, name, type, normal balance, and statutory mapping.
Records of vehicles entering or exiting a defined geofence boundary.
Business-language definitions of concepts, with steward, related terms, synonyms, and certification status.
Confirmations that ordered goods or services were received as expected, recording receipt date, quantity, and condition, used in invoice matching before payment.
Continuous vehicle location stream of timestamp, latitude, longitude, speed, and heading, powering maps and geofence checks.
Grazing paddocks or fields, with area, location, pasture type, carrying capacity, and rest state, that grazing plans rotate livestock across.
Rotational-grazing plans over a set of paddocks, covering rotation order, rest periods, stocking rate, and carrying-capacity targets for a season.
Committed go-to-market plans for a period, the parent artifact that locks and pushes work downstream.
What-if models of a go-to-market plan under alternative segment, territory, capacity, or channel assumptions.
Witnessed electronic signatures binding learner, course, content version, and timestamp for regulated life-sciences training.
Per-product food-safety plans documenting hazard analysis, critical control points, limits, monitoring, and corrective actions.
Statutory acknowledgments that harassment training was completed, carrying a signed timestamp and IP address.
Physical IT assets such as laptops, servers, network gear, and peripherals, with serial number, asset tag, current user or location, and lifecycle state.
Decommissioning records for retired hardware, covering e-waste tracking, chain of custody, and data-wipe compliance.
Catalog of hardware device types, SKUs, and specifications, used to match assets to refreshable units.
Manufacturer support contracts for hardware assets, with coverage terms and expiration tracking.
Field-level harvest projections translated into available-share and SKU planning, driving reserve lists and dynamic pricing.
Per-field and per-zone yield records from combine telemetry, scale tickets, and grain-handling reconciliation.
Scheduled lifts of a vessel out of and back into the water using a travel lift or crane, with time spent on the hard.
Identified workplace hazards, their source and affected tasks, and the controls applied to reduce their risk.
Approved org slots with role definition, cost center, reporting line, location, and FTE allocation. Each can be open, filled, or eliminated.
Period-by-period headcount targets broken down by org unit, location, function, level, and type, with openings, additions, and reductions.
Helm deployment records, tracking chart name and version, value overrides, namespace, and installed status.
Hiring plans that close a capacity gap, defining roles, timing, and ramp, handed to recruiting and finance.
Assignments of specific users to recruiter, hiring manager, coordinator, interviewer, and reviewer roles on a single requisition.
Bindings between a visitor and an internal employee host, covering access scope, duration, and supervision responsibility.
Employee inquiries and service requests routed to HR operations, such as pay questions, benefits changes, leave requests, and complaints.
Assignable, claimable units of human work generated by running processes, with candidate users, due date, priority, and form, completed to advance the process.
Infrastructure-level access-control artifacts such as bucket policies, role grants, and database permissions.
Definitions of the best-fit account, covering firmographics, technographics, and qualifying criteria used to target engagement.
Identity-resolution edges linking email, device, cookie, login, and phone, turning anonymous interactions into resolved customers.
Records of engine-running, vehicle-stationary state changes, distinct from trip aggregation.
Models trained to extract structured fields from documents such as invoices, contracts, and forms, with training lineage, metrics, and version.
Reusable extraction definitions per document type, covering field structure, validation rules, and target-system mapping.
Validation outcomes for extracted fields, carrying the rule applied, pass/fail/review status, exception details, and resolution state.
Access review and certification campaigns with per-user attestation outcomes.
User-initiated access requests and their approval workflow within an identity-governance platform.
Business-role and entitlement templates provisioned into downstream systems.
Per-target outcomes of an orchestrated provisioning action, such as success, failure, or retry.
Segregation-of-duties policy violations and their exception-approval records.
Governance view of a user's access to an application: the entitlement grant, who requested and approved it, when it was last certified, and when revoked.
In-house legal matters such as disputes, transactions, advisory, IP, and regulatory responses, with client department, parties, counsel, budget, and status.
Proactive forecasts of likely service-impacting incidents within a coming time window.
Physical plant, equipment, and infrastructure tracked for maintenance and lifecycle, with asset tag, location, manufacturer, criticality, and current state.
Industrial-hygiene sampling and exposure-monitoring results for chemical, noise, or other agents, measured against occupational exposure limits.
Creator and influencer profiles, with audience metrics, content history, contracts, payments, and campaign attribution.
Purchase orders from an agency to a specific media outlet, committing budget at negotiated rates, reconciled against the outlet's invoice.
Prioritized alerts raised when correlated indicators cross a risk threshold for a user, triaged and escalated into a case when warranted.
Investigation cases on suspected insider threats, covering the lifecycle from triage to disposition, the activity timeline, evidence, and HR or legal handoff.
Customer-owned equipment that the service organization installs and maintains, with identity, placement, and lifecycle state, covered by work orders and contracts.
Assignments of an instructor to a session or offering, with role such as primary, assistant, or observer.
Instructor records covering internal trainers, contracted experts, and external vendor instructors, kept separate from employees.
Insurance claim records from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement, with claim type, dates, claimant, adjuster, status, and liability.
Underwritten insurance policies defining coverage terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and effective dates, against which claims are filed.
Connector definitions for third-party applications, each with its authentication type.
Transformation rules mapping a source field to a target field, with mapping logic and transformation type.
Higher-level orchestrations that compose multiple pipelines and connectors into an integration flow.
Named, versioned templates for recurring event-driven integration flows.
Execution logs per integration run, with timestamp, status, input and output references, error log, and latency.
Event sources that start an integration, such as schedules, webhooks, database changes, or queues, with polling or push configuration.
Configured sources feeding competitive intelligence, such as news, review sites, web monitors, and field reports.
Intent specifications with training phrases, entities, and resolution rules that drive intent detection at runtime.
Language-understanding outputs, recording the detected intent, confidence, originating utterance, and downstream action taken.
Captured buying-intent signals for an account or contact, with topic, source, and strength.
Supervisor quality reviews of a recorded interaction, scored against a form with section and item scores, comments, agent acknowledgment, and coaching flag.
Transactions between two legal entities of the same group, such as intercompany invoices, transfers, and allocations, driving consolidation eliminations.
Patron requests to borrow material from another library, with routing across sharing partners, shipping status, and fulfillment workflow.
Internal opportunity postings covering full-time roles, gigs, projects, stretch assignments, and mentorships.
Reusable interview templates per role and stage, bundling questions, target competencies, recommended scorecard, and expected duration.
